doctrine: ELIMINATE any platform with restrictive rate limits (< 100 req/hr unauthenticated) OR low-quality output. Keep ONLY primary authoritative sources with generous/no rate limits and high-fidelity structured data.

platforms.name: USAspending.gov (FiscalData Treasury)
platforms.rate_limit: No published hard limit; keyless, polite caching
platforms.data: Federal spending, agency budgets, awards, contracts, debt to the penny

platforms.name: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS)
platforms.data: CPI, unemployment, payroll, productivity, occupational employment stats

platforms.name: Federal Reserve (FRED)
platforms.data: 815,000+ US/international economic time series
platforms.quality: PRIMARY - St. Louis Fed official data

platforms.name: SEC EDGAR (company filings)
platforms.rate_limit: No published limit; keyless; be polite (10 req/sec)
platforms.auth: None for browse; token for submission APIs
platforms.data: All public company filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, XBRL financials)

platforms.name: IMF / World Bank / OECD / BIS
platforms.data: Global macro, debt, trade, financial stability indicators

platforms.name: ClinicalTrials.gov v2 (NIH/NLM)
platforms.data: 500k+ clinical studies worldwide, protocols, results, sponsors

platforms.name: openFDA (FDA)
platforms.data: Drug labels (SPL), adverse events (FAERS), recalls, NDC, 510(k)

platforms.name: PubMed / PubMedCentral (NLM)
platforms.data: 36M+ biomedical citations, 8M+ full-text articles

platforms.name: WHO / CDC / NIH data portals
platforms.rate_limit: Keyless Socrata/ODATA; app token lifts throttle
platforms.data: Global health observatory, US public health datasets, surveillance

platforms.name: ChEMBL (EBI/EMBL-EBI)
platforms.rate_limit: No hard limit at moderate volume; keyless
platforms.data: Curated bioactivity (IC50, Ki, Kd), compounds, targets, assays

platforms.name: CourtListener (Free Law Project)
platforms.data: 8.3M+ US judicial opinions, federal RECAP/PACER dockets, citations
platforms.note: Rate limit is RESTRICTIVE for high-volume; use BULK DATA (CSV) for bulk needs

platforms.name: GovInfo (GPO)
platforms.auth: Optional API key for higher limits
platforms.data: Official publications from all 3 branches: Federal Register, CFR, US Code, Congressional docs

platforms.name: USPTO (patents & trademarks)
platforms.rate_limit: Keyless for bulk; API key for search
platforms.data: 11M+ patents, trademark register, PTAB decisions, OCE data

platforms.name: Legislation.gov.uk / EUR-Lex / EUR-Lex SPARQL
platforms.data: UK/EU legislation, case law, consolidated texts

platforms.name: arXiv (Cornell)
platforms.data: 2.4M+ preprints (physics, math, CS, econ, bio, etc.)

platforms.name: Semantic Scholar (Allen Institute)
platforms.data: 200M+ papers, citations, references, embeddings, TLDRs

platforms.name: Crossref / DataCite
platforms.data: 140M+ DOI metadata, citations, funding, license info

platforms.name: IETF / RFC Editor / W3C / ISO
platforms.data: Internet standards (RFCs), Web standards, International standards

platforms.name: CORE (Open Access papers)
platforms.data: 240M+ open access papers metadata + full text where available

platforms.name: docs.rs (Rust)
platforms.data: All crates.io crate docs, rustdoc JSON, search, cross-crate links

platforms.name: crates.io / PyPI / npm / Maven Central
platforms.data: Package metadata, versions, dependencies, readmes, SBOM data

platforms.name: MDN (Mozilla Developer Network)
platforms.data: Web platform reference, browser compat, specs, tutorials

platforms.name: Kubernetes / Docker / CNCF projects
platforms.data: API reference, concepts, tasks, container images, SBOM

platforms.name: GitHub (code search + raw) - WITH TOKEN ONLY
platforms.data: Code search, raw source files, repos, releases, advisories (GHSA)

eliminated_platforms.name: Wikipedia / Wikimedia
eliminated_platforms.reason: Editable by anyone; documented vandalism/manipulation risk; not primary source

eliminated_platforms.name: Reddit / StackOverflow / dev.to / Quora / Medium
eliminated_platforms.reason: Community content; useful but lowest trust; anecdotal not authoritative

eliminated_platforms.name: GitHub raw.githubusercontent.com (keyless)
eliminated_platforms.reason: 60 req/hr/IP - TOO RESTRICTIVE; blocks production use

eliminated_platforms.name: CourtListener REST API (unauthenticated)
eliminated_platforms.reason: 5 req/min / 125/day - TOO RESTRICTIVE for production; use bulk CSV instead

eliminated_platforms.name: DrugBank
eliminated_platforms.reason: Commercial license required; academic free but license trap

eliminated_platforms.name: Generic web search engines (DDG/Bing/Mojeek)
eliminated_platforms.reason: Return mixed quality; secondary sources; noise; use only as discovery fallback

integration_strategy.primary_engines: Each domain gets dedicated engine(s) with no rate limits or generous keyless access
integration_strategy.fallback_chain: Official API -> Bulk data (CSV/Parquet) -> Structured scrape (if no API) -> Eliminate
integration_strategy.auth_handling: Optional env var tokens (GITHUB_TOKEN, SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_KEY, NCBI_API_KEY, COURTLISTENER_TOKEN) - never hardcoded
integration_strategy.rate_limit_behavior: Built-in retry-with-backoff (already in client.rs) + per-engine circuit breaker + proxy pool rotation
